name: eethCross
summary: 支持关卡编辑与创意工坊的彩色数织游戏。官方披露部分界面基础、音乐和背景特效使用生成工具，并声明核心游戏与谜题逻辑由开发者编写。

sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Some UI/UX scaffolding, music, and background VFX were produced with generative tools. Gameplay code and puzzle logic are written and maintained by the developer, who can explain and modify every line. The core game was implemented by hand.

sources.label: I'm the dev, ask anything
sources.excerpt: The developer invites feedback. Players discuss window size, visual effects and puzzle controls; a visible developer reply acknowledges the feedback. No additional AI-use scope is established.

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 完整披露、身份和英文界面讨论区首页（1 个主题）。另读 1 个主题正文及可见回复。每款游戏单独检索公开报道；讨论区仅覆盖首页，搜索并非穷尽。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
